title: Nourishing Spanish Fiordilatte Quiche
description: A light yet indulgent quiche that marries Spanish flavors with the creamy richness of fiordilatte. Perfect for a flexitarian lunch with a flaky crust and savory filling.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and press the pie crust into a 9-inch tart pan.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and fiordilatte until smooth.
Stir in the shredded Manchego, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic until translucent.
Add the chopped spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, then remove from heat.
Combine the sautéed vegetables with the egg and cheese mixture, mixing well.
Pour the filling into the prepared crust, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the quiche is set and the top is lightly golden.
Let the quiche rest for 5 minutes before slicing into wedges.
Serve warm, optionally garnished with a sprinkle of fresh herbs or a drizzle of olive oil.
